text: Stop the verifier from changing its snapshot instead of only detecting the change afterwards. Today crates/athena-core/src/run.rs (around line 959) compares HEAD and the work tree after the verifier runs, and verify.rs turns any difference into a blocker that rejects the job. Change this so the verifier runs against a snapshot it cannot write to (for example a read-only copy or a deny on writes in the verifier grant). If the fingerprint still differs, throw that verdict away, run verification once more on a fresh snapshot, and record a system fault, not a rejection of the work. Add tests that show a verifier's write attempt leaves the snapshot unchanged and that a changed fingerprint triggers exactly one rerun. Done when those tests pass along with cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy and cargo test.
